integrity: Existing regularity and finite-field corank results are credited explicitly. The joint defect law, its asymptotic conditioned distribution, and negative dependence are proved in the accompanying result. No independent scientific audit was conducted.
limitations: Fixed finite field for the joint large-block limit; two blocks only; finite checks cover prime fields in small dimensions; possible unindexed equivalent formulas.
title: Defect-pair Gibbs law for regular finite-field subspace-preserving endomorphisms
